scripts.deploy:backend:sandbox: npm run fly:config -- ../Backend/infra/fly/fly.toml sandbox | npm run deploy:to:fly
scripts.deploy:backend:staging: npm run fly:config -- ../Backend/infra/fly/fly.toml staging | npm run deploy:to:fly
scripts.deploy:backend:production: npm run fly:config -- ../Backend/infra/fly/fly.toml production | npm run deploy:to:fly
scripts.deploy:to:fly: tail -n 1 | xargs -Ixx cp xx Backend/.fly.toml && cd Backend && flyctl deploy --config=.fly.toml
scripts.deploy:worker:sandbox: npm run fly:config -- ../Backend/infra/fly/fly-jobs.toml sandbox | npm run deploy:to:fly
scripts.deploy:worker:production: npm run fly:config -- ../Backend/infra/fly/fly-jobs.toml production | npm run deploy:to:fly
scripts.compose:up:attach-api: npm run compose -- up -d && npm run compose -- attach api_dev
